description: This file contains the implementation of the 'VoucherTheme' controller class for the OpenCart admin panel. It manages CRUD operations and views related to voucher themes, including listing, creating, editing, and saving voucher themes within the admin interface.

classes.name: VoucherTheme
classes.description: Controller class for managing voucher themes in the OpenCart admin panel. Handles listing, adding, editing, and saving voucher themes with validation and view rendering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point for voucher theme management; loads language, sets page title, gathers URL parameters, builds breadcrumbs, and loads the list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the display of the voucher themes list by initializing language, loading the list data, and rendering the view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Internal method to fetch voucher themes with sorting, ordering, and pagination; prepares data for listing view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a voucher theme, populating fields if editing an existing theme.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submissions for creating or updating a voucher theme, including permissions check, validation, and database updates.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of selected voucher themes, including permission check and bulk delete operations.
